selection_reason: APW-05 completed_verified in PR #441. CSW-03 through CSW-08 satisfy CSW-09 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects CSW-09 before APW-06.
objective: Define the Creator Command Center and assistance integration so returning creators can immediately see what they were doing, what deserves attention and how to continue across Projects, Writing, Ideas, Continuity, Reuse and Creator Workshop while preserving Personal/Campaign/project context, authorization-before-aggregation and visible optional-assistance source scope.
completion_gate: A returning creator can immediately identify active work, ideas/open threads/needs-attention states, recent/unused material and relevant Campaign usage; navigate back to exact context; search/command across authorized creator resources; and invoke optional assistance with visible context/source scope while core organization/resume workflows remain useful with no AI.
required_design_questions: What Creator Command Center surfaces are essential and how are they ranked without coercive engagement mechanics?

How are Continue Writing, Ideas to Develop, Open Threads, Needs Attention, Recently Created, Unused Material, Drafts, Story Bible and Campaigns Using My Work projected from owning systems rather than duplicated truth?
What exact Personal/Project/Campaign context indicators and return-to-context tokens are required?
How are counts, recents, search, related work and usage projections authorization-filtered before aggregation?
How do deep links recover when the target moved, changed version, lost permission or is offline?
What universal creator command palette/query model spans CSW and APW-05 without becoming a generic authority bypass?
How do optional assistant entry points show exact source/context scope, capabilities, cost/provider policy and candidate-only behavior?
Which deterministic/no-AI commands and suggestions provide equivalent core organization/development value?
How are creator reminders/task hooks modeled without pressure/streak dark patterns and without assuming scheduler implementation?
How do APW-05 Workshop/Sandbox results appear in recent/continue/needs-review without confusing Sandbox state with reusable truth?
How are multi-project and Campaign-usage relationships shown without leaking protected Campaign details?
What mobile/accessibility/empty/offline/recovery acceptance proves a creator can resume work without reconstructing state manually?
next_action: Execute CSW-09 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining Creator Command Center projections/ranking, context-safe deep links/resume, creator search/command behavior, APW-05 Workshop integration, visible optional-assistance scope, no-AI parity and accessibility/offline/recovery acceptance.
